briefdescription.para: Wave D — Chaos High-Cardinality Stress Tests.

detaileddescription.para: Stress tests for the chaos module covering high-cardinality scenarios: 200 distinct fault descriptors, 4-thread concurrent inject/recover, and the scheduler under 50 concurrent faults.
These tests are excluded from the fast release_critical gate and are intended for Wave D stress validation pipelines.

listitem.para: HighCardinalityFaultDescriptors — 200 distinct fault descriptors, all injected
